visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male cyclist wearing a light blue professional jersey and a white helmet rides on a paved asphalt path. He is wearing red-tinted sunglasses, and the scene is brightly lit by natural daylight. Lush green trees line the side of the path under a clear blue sky. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a pair of hands holding a black Garmin Edge 850 device over a light-colored wooden table. The device's screen is active, showing a main menu with colorful icons. The lighting transitions to bright indoor studio lighting. (3) A side-by-side graphical comparison appears on screen, showing the larger Garmin Edge 1050 next to the more compact Edge 850. Textual data overlays compare their screen sizes and weights in a clean, informative layout. (4) The camera provides a macro close-up of the Edge 850 screen as a finger swipes through a detailed topological map. The map displays various street names, green parks, and a red arrow indicating the user's current location. (5) The setting shifts back to an outdoor bike path adjacent to a large body of water with a concrete sea wall. The device is mounted on the bike's handlebars, displaying real-time weather conditions and a smart refill notification for hydration. (6) A detailed shot shows the installation of the device onto black carbon fiber road bike handlebars. The bike features red accents, and the device screen displays performance metrics such as power, cadence, and heart rate during a ride. (7) A woman in a black shirt stands in front of a Garmin branded retail store, holding the original product packaging toward the camera. The video concludes with a back view of the cyclist riding away into the distance.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo electronic dance music (EDM) starts immediately, featuring a strong four-on-the-floor beat and bright synth melodies. A male voice begins a clear, enthusiastic narration with high pitch variability and a friendly, energetic tone. There are no ambient noises. (2) A sharp 'click' sound effect triggers as a UI element appears on screen. The narrator continues speaking at a fast pace, describing his cycling experience. The music maintains a constant rhythm with high-frequency electronic textures in the background. (3) A digital 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition to a comparison segment. The narrator's voice remains dominant and projected, with professional articulation. The music's intensity remains high, providing a dynamic backdrop to the speech-heavy content. (4) A 'ding' sound effect occurs as technical specifications are mentioned. The narrator's pitch rises slightly for emphasis. The mix is clean, with the voice centered and the music slightly ducked to ensure maximum vocal clarity and engagement. (5) A 'pop' sound effect is heard when the map interface is demonstrated. Faint ambient wind noise is introduced as the scene shifts to an outdoor recording, but the primary vocal track remains studio-quality. (6) A distinct 'notification chime' sound effect triggers during the mention of the smart refill feature. The music's synth layers become more complex, and the narrator maintains a high arousal level, sounding very positive throughout. (7) A final percussive 'hit' sound effect marks the end of the feature list. The music begins to fade out as the narrator gives a concluding summary. The audio track ends abruptly with a hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Product Introduction -> Feature Comparison -> Detailed Demonstration -> Summary
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Garmin Edge 850 by highlighting its lightweight hardware and advanced software features such as high-precision GPS, smart nutrition alerts, and group connectivity. The video targets cycling enthusiasts looking for a compact but powerful performance tracking device.
